Saving feels clear, and the pre-filled title and description are exactly what I had in mind. Starting with one example was helpful.

I would change two things:

- When I type tags, please suggest tags I already use—such as “javascript” or “reference”—so I don’t accidentally create slightly different versions of the same tag. Comma-separated entry is otherwise fine.
- I expected the app to collect the page’s icon and a preview image too, and show at least the icon in the saved list.

The note box is the right idea, but I’d like it to support a proper longer note with simple formatting, rather than treating it as only one quick line. I’ll also need to be able to edit the link and all these details after saving, though that can be shown in the next step.
